content_sections.heading: Burari Hospital Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the Burari Hospital Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download Burari Hospital Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Residents: MBBS with Post graduate degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent in concerned specialty. In case of non-availability of MD/DNB certificate, candidates with 02 years experience in concerned department will be considered on Ad-hoc Basis.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Senior Residents: Maximum age is 45 years. Age relaxation applicable: SC & ST: 5 years, OBC: 3 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: In accordance with 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Burari Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Burari Hospital for filling up various medical posts on a contract basis in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 22 vacant posts for Senior Residents across different departments like OBG, Anaesthesia, Microbiology, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for Burari Hospital recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly to the designated venue with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a Postgraduate degree, DNB, Diploma, or equivalent qualification in the concerned specialty.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and OBC as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary is provided in accordance with the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) guidelines as adopted by the GNCT of Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview process begins on 29 September 2026 and extends until 13 October 2026 for eligible medical professionals.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original and self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification and further details?
faq.answer: Candidates can check the official notification PDF and other important updates through the designated links provided in the important links section.
